Minimum age 18 years with valid government-issued photo ID

blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving where they are securely attached to an experienced instructor who manages the jump. The jump includes a 15-minute flight to altitude, about 30 seconds of freefall at 120 mph, and a parachute canopy flight before landing. Guests check in, complete paperwork, watch an informational video, and receive ground training before the jump.
extraNote: Arrive 30 minutes before scheduled appointment · Plan for up to 4 hours at dropzone; weather may delay or cancel jump · No personal cameras allowed during jump due to USPA safety rules · Tipping instructors is appreciated but not expected · Ozarks Skydive Center dropzone at 3103 Lawrence 1070, Miller, Missouri, 65707
